The recruitment includes Deputy Director, State Program Manager, District Program Manager, Thematic Expert, Accountant, Assistant-cum-Data Entry Operator and other positions at state, district and block levels.

content_sections.heading: JSHPS Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The official JSHPS Recruitment 2026 notification provides complete details about the 637 vacancies, reservation, eligibility criteria, salary, professional experience, selection process and application instructions. Candidates are advised to read the notification before submitting their applications. View JSHPS Recruitment 2026 Official Notification

content_sections.heading: JSHPS Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The JSHPS online application process starts on 04 November 2026. Candidates must complete the online form and the subsequent hard-copy submission within the prescribed deadlines.

content_sections.heading: JSHPS Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: JSHPS has announced 637 vacancies across headquarters, district and block-level offices. These vacancies cover administrative, technical, financial, horticulture and data entry positions.

content_sections.heading: JSHPS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the post-specific educational qualifications, professional experience and age requirements. Eligibility conditions differ for senior management, technical, district and block-level positions. Important: Applicants must also meet the specific essential and desirable experience requirements mentioned in the official notification. Qualifications alone may not establish eligibility for positions requiring professional experience.

content_sections.heading: JSHPS Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit varies depending on the post. Senior positions have higher prescribed age ranges, while block-level and data entry positions have different limits. Candidates should verify the age calculation date, category-wise age relaxation and other applicable provisions in the official notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: JSHPS Recruitment 2026 Apply Online Link
content_sections.text: The online application portal opens on 04 November 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their applications until 04 December 2026 at 3:00 PM through the official Jharkhand recruitment website. JSHPS Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

content_sections.heading: JSHPS Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay the prescribed application fee according to their category. The fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee for each application, where required.

rows.category: Eligible Jharkhand PwD Candidates (40% or more disability)

content_sections.heading: JSHPS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the provisions specified in the official recruitment notification. Candidates will be assessed according to their educational qualifications, relevant professional experience and the applicable selection criteria. The recruitment procedure may include scrutiny of applications, preparation of a shortlist, assessment of eligible candidates and verification of original documents as prescribed by JSHPS. Candidates should read the official notification carefully for the selection methodology, assessment weightage, tie-breaking provisions and applicable reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JSHPS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply through the official Jharkhand recruitment portal. Applicants should complete the online application and submit the printed form with the prescribed supporting documents within the respective deadlines. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in JSHPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: JSHPS has announced 637 contractual vacancies for various state, district and block-level posts, including Program Manager, Accountant, Thematic Expert and Assistant-cum-Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for JSHPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 04 December 2026 at 3:00 PM. The printed application with supporting documents must reach the prescribed office by 14 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for JSHPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from ₹20,000 to ₹1,00,000, depending on the post. A performance-linked annual increment of 5% is also mentioned in the advertisement, subject to conditions.

faq.question: Q4. What qualifications are required for JSHPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The qualifications vary by post and include relevant graduate and postgraduate degrees, BCA, B.Sc (IT), MCA, B.Tech, MBA, CA and other prescribed qualifications. Several positions also require relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply online for JSHPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply through recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in. They must also submit the printed application along with the required documents to the designated office by the prescribed deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Unreserved, OBC, and EWS category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500, whereas SC and ST candidates pay Rs. 300.

faq.question: Q7. How do I submit the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: After submitting online, take a printout, attach self-attested copies of required documents and fee receipt, and send it by hand or registered/speed post to the Chief Executive Officer, JSHPS, Ranchi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for JSHPS recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written test (if applicant numbers exceed 15 times the vacancy count) followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: All positions offered under this recruitment drive are purely on a contractual basis for one year, renewable based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply through the official recruitment portal at recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in using the direct apply link provided in the important links section.
